```text
# #2067: CI: daily super run failed
Opened by @github-actions[bot].

[super run 40509811140](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/40509811140) on `main` (`0e9a816`, schedule) failed:

| Job | Result |
|---|---|
| [fuzz (2/4)](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/40509811140/job/122211880305) | failure |
| [fuzz (3/4)](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/40509811140/job/122211880395) | failure |
| [fuzz (1/4)](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/40509811140/job/122211880491) | failure |
| [fuzz (4/4)](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/40509811140/job/122211880858) | failure |
| [e2e component (chrome)](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/40509811140/job/122212507198) | failure |
| [e2e (3/8)](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/40509811140/job/122212507301) | failure |

Each link opens that job's log. This issue stays open while the run is red and the next run that passes every job closes it. `gh workflow run super.yml --ref <branch>` runs it again on demand.

Night bot: this run is on `main`, so it is yours. Root-cause each failed job from its log and fix it in a pull request: a flake is not a root cause, so make a flaky test robust instead of re-running it, and never skip, disable or quarantine a test to get green. Reproduce it with the job's own command (CLAUDE.md, Commands; one fuzz seed is `cargo jackioh fuzz --from <seed> --seeds 1`, with `--handicap` for the handicapped wave and `--duos` for the Duos wave; a daily test is `cargo test -p <crate> <name> -- --ignored`). A pull request's CI runs only the e2e smoke specs and leaves the tests marked `#[ignore = "daily: …"]` out, so say in the pull request which job here the fix makes pass and how you checked it. You cannot change `.github/`: make the part of the fix that lives elsewhere, and when the rest needs a workflow or an action, give the exact lines to change there and ask a person to make them.

---
_Posted by `.github/workflows/super.yml`._
```

# Draft plan for #2067 (daily super run failed on 0e9a816)

Failed jobs: fuzz 1-4/4, e2e component (chrome), e2e (3/8).
e2e 3/8 specs: 02-prompts, 28-patch-011-ui, 35-settings-dialog, 38-accessibility, 45-economy-loop.
No GitHub log access: must reproduce locally.

## Progress
- main's release binary at /tmp/j2067/jackioh (CARGO_TARGET_DIR shared: /home/runner/work/JackiOh/JackiOh/target)
- plain fuzz 1..10000 on main -> /tmp/j2067/plain.log: 4 failures, one per quarter (A x3, B x1)
- scratch copy /tmp/j2067/repo: fix A -> /tmp/j2067/target; fix A + B (+ env-gated J2067 trace) -> /tmp/j2067/target-dbg
- handicap 1..10000 with fix A: all pass. Duos with fix A: running (duos-fixed.log)
- WASM build running (wasm.log); then component specs + e2e shard 3
- JACKIOH_CACHE_DIR=/home/runner/work/JackiOh/JackiOh/.cache has emsdk + wasm-bindgen
- Cypress 16.1.0 verified; local chrome 155 (CI pins 154 via e2e/support/chrome-pin.ts, E2E_CHROME_PIN=1)

## Findings
### Fuzz A (seeds 2276 q1, 2536 q2, 7340 q3, plain): I6 oracle false positive — CONFIRMED, fix VERIFIED
- I6 hidden definition at view.events[k].pieces[j] (`starshipLaunched`), the original piece now in its
  owner's library/hand. Seed 2276: Starship c71 launched with pieces [stinkyscape-122,...], then destroyed
  -> graveyard (R78 drops `CardInstance.starship`), launch still in view.events (last N).
  hidden_from (invariants.rs ~773) excuses piece defs only via a held Starship's memory.
  R1852005: pieces are "the public memory of a public launch"; view_for.rs 2516 passes them.
- Fix: `hidden_information_violations` builds `events: Vec<Value>`; for a view event whose aligned raw
  source is `GameEvent::StarshipLaunched { pieces, .. }`, drop from its "pieces" array the defs the raw
  source named (new fn `drop_launched_pieces`), then insert `Value::Array(events)`.

### Fuzz B (seed 9688 q4, plain, start dealt): settle panic (24000 passes) — CONFIRMED, fix VERIFIED
- Loop: core-021 Hinder (cast on draw, discards 1 random) + classic-064 Malzahar's Recycler ("whenever
  you discard, draw that many", a queued trigger => each draw is a fresh R58 chain per R217) +
  core-033 Unstable Clone Machine (shuffles 3 copies per play, library stays at LIBRARY_CAP). Endless.
- Fix: new rule R2067000: one action casts at most CAST_ON_DRAW_ACTION_CAP = LIBRARY_CAP (60) cast-on-draw
  cards over all its chains; past it a cast-on-draw card goes to hand uncast as R58's 21st.
  Counter: `Frontier.cast_on_draw_casts: i32` (triggers.rs, shared by every sink of the action, never
  serialized). draw.rs complete_draw: condition + increment beside `cast_chain = Some(at.chain + 1)`.
  Tried LIBRARY_CAP*CHAIN_CAP (1200): loop ends but action emits 11075 events > GROWTH_EVENTS_BOUND 10000.
  With 60: seed passes, heaviest action 583 events.
- Needs: ruling note, spec/INDEX via `cargo jackioh spec index`, cross test (plays_and_casts.rs pattern
  r217 test), config test, classify --claims (maybe a patches fragment --rule/--plays).
